closure_evidence.narrative: This is a review-type router item, not an implementation. The claimed numbers are the load-bearing artifact (they replace a derived estimate in PRODUCTION-CANDIDATE §4 item 2 with a measured one), so the verification consisted of checking those numbers against the raw JSON receipts rather than re-running the benchmark (re-running would not have added confidence beyond confirming the sender's own arithmetic, and the both-busy regime requires the specific M5x4/M1x2 CPU-hog harness already run and receipted). Open threads named in the item (helper-socket MPI_Init failure -- mine as shim owner; item 4 NIC hardware location -- an owner question) are carried forward, not resolved here, and are not blocking for this close.
